title: Abrade
summary: ABRA'DE, verb transitive [Latin abrado, to scrape, from rado.] To rub or wear off; to waste by friction; used especially to express the action of sharp, corrosive medicines, in wearing away or removin

inlines.v: ABRA'DE, verb transitive [Latin abrado, to scrape, from rado.] To rub or wear off; to waste by friction; used especially to express the action of sharp, corrosive medicines, in wearing away or removing the mucus of the membranes.
